name: obsidian
description: Turn papers, book chapters and web clippings into a maintained Obsidian knowledge base: name and file PDFs, split books into chapters, extract figures, summarise research papers with their key figures and limitations, clean clippings into notes, build interlinked wiki entries, and keep the vault linted and navigable.

interface.shortDescription: Turn papers and clippings into a maintained Obsidian vault
interface.longDescription: Turn papers, book chapters and web clippings into a maintained Obsidian knowledge base: name and file PDFs, split books into chapters, extract figures, summarise research papers with their key figures and limitations, clean clippings into notes, build interlinked wiki entries, and keep the vault linted and navigable.
defaultPrompt: Organize the PDFs and process the web clippings in my Obsidian inbox.
Summarize a research paper with its key figures in my Obsidian vault.
Audit the wiki entries and rebuild my maps of content.
